methods.steps: File > Open; review Text Import; File > Export As > Export as PDF.
methods.limits: Import delimiters and export page range require review.

methods.steps: Data > From Text/CSV; inspect imported columns; File > Save As; choose PDF.
methods.limits: Print area and inferred data types can change the report.

methods.steps: Open the CSV; Adjust Import Settings if needed; File > Export To > PDF.
methods.limits: Spreadsheet import and page layout must be checked.

methods.steps: Open the PSD; File > Export As; set the JPEG Quality level; progressive is an Advanced Option.
File > Open; File > Export As > JPG.
methods.limits: The output is a flat image.

methods.steps: magick input.psd output.jpg
methods.limits: A layered PSD can write one JPG per layer.

methods.steps: Import and select the CR2; export module: target storage file on disk, file format JPEG; start export.
magick cr2:portrait.cr2 portrait.jpg
methods.limits: CR2 needs the explicit cr2: specifier.

methods.steps: File > Save a Copy; choose Portable Document Format (*.pdf); embed fonts for searchable text.
cairosvg drawing.svg -o drawing.pdf
methods.limits: Text and font support is limited; animation and scripting are not implemented.

methods.steps: magick diagram.svg diagram.pdf
methods.limits: PDF support requires Ghostscript.

methods.steps: Open the TIFF; File > Export As; set the JPEG Quality level.
methods.limits: Export formats other than XCF lose some image properties.

methods.steps: magick scan.tif scan-copy.jpg
ffmpeg -i library.m4v -c copy library-remux.mp4
methods.limits: Stream copy may fail if the container needs information the source lacks; default selection picks one video, one audio and one subtitle stream.

methods.steps: Open Source; keep the default Fast 1080p30 preset; set destination under To; Start.
methods.limits: This re-encodes the video.

methods.steps: Media > Convert/Save; Add the M4V; set Destination file; choose profile Video - H.264 + MP3 (MP4); Start.
methods.limits: The profile's audio codec is MP3.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i interview.mov -vn -c:a pcm_s16le interview-audio.wav
methods.limits: Without -map, FFmpeg picks the audio stream itself.

methods.steps: Import the MOV (FFmpeg library needed except on Mac); File > Export Audio; Save as type WAV; Signed 16-bit PCM encoding.
methods.limits: Import depends on the FFmpeg library being installed.

methods.steps: Media > Convert/Save; Add the MOV; Profile Audio - CD; .wav destination; Start.
methods.limits: The profile writes 16-bit PCM, stereo, 44,100 Hz.

methods.steps: Select the DNG; export module; target storage file on disk; format JPEG; start export.
methods.limits: Non-Bayer sensors are not decoded, except Fujifilm X-Trans.

methods.steps: File > Open the ICO; File > Export As; choose PNG and set its options.
methods.limits: GIMP's ICO loader is a file plug-in; the PNG dialog offers compression, interlacing and metadata options.

methods.steps: magick application.ico icon-copy.png
methods.limits: The formats list marks ICO as readable.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i lecture.mp4 -vn -c:a libvorbis -q:a 5 lecture-sound.ogg
methods.limits: Needs libvorbis compiled into the build; without -map, FFmpeg picks the audio stream.

methods.steps: Import the MP4 (FFmpeg library needed except on Mac); File > Export Audio; Ogg Vorbis; quality slider.
methods.limits: Import depends on the FFmpeg library being installed on Windows and Linux.

methods.steps: Media > Convert/Save; Add the MP4; Profile Audio - Vorbis (OGG); .ogg destination; Start.
methods.limits: The profile writes 128 kbps stereo at 44,100 Hz with video disabled.
